Proof in the paper: The lattice fringes of the Rh NP in Rh/Al2O3 exhibit d spacings of 0.22 nm (Fig. 1b), which can be indexed to the (111) plane of fcc Rh, while those of Rh–Ni NPs possessed a slightly smaller d spacing value of 0.21 nm (Fig. 1d) which may reflect either (111) planes of the parent fcc Rh NPs or RhNi alloy NPs.
